listen_ip.description: IP address for BitlBee to listen on (empty or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)

port.description: TCP port for IRC client connections

protocol.description: IP protocol version to use for listening

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed

max_accounts_per_user.description: Maximum number of IM accounts a single user may register

max_message_length.description: Maximum length (in bytes) for a single message (excluding control chars)

debug.description: Enable extra-verbose debug mode (affects logging level)

log_file.description: Path to the main log file (use '/dev/stdout' in containers)

auth_mode.description: Authentication method: 'password' for IRC-level auth, 'unix' for local socket trust

root_dir.description: Root directory for persistent data (accounts, settings, etc.)

im_command.description: Path to the IMC process binary (do not change unless installing plugins)

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which the client is disconnected

reconnect_delay.description: Seconds to wait before attempting to reconnect to an IM service

reconnect_max_tries.description: Maximum reconnect attempts before giving up on an account

allow_nick_changes.description: Allow users to change their IRC nicknames via /NICK

allow_register.description: Allow new accounts to be registered via the IRC interface

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for client connections (recommended for remote access)

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format)

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format)

ssl_chain_path.description: Optional path to an intermediate certificate chain file

ssl_verify.description: Require clients to present valid SSL certificates (client-side cert auth)

hostname.description: Public hostname to advertise in server messages and SSL redirects

outgoing_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to bind to for outgoing connections (e.g., ['eth0'])

dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC validation for outgoing DNS lookups

dns_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for DNS resolution before failing

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable IPv6 for outgoing IM connections (services permitting)

proxy.description: Outgoing proxy configuration (for environments with strict outbound filtering)

plugins.description: List of paths to additional plugin binaries to load on startup

plugin_options.description: Per-plugin configuration key-value pairs (used by dynamic plugins)

value.description: Config value (as it appears in the config file)

allowed_protocols.description: List of protocols allowed for new accounts (see 'protocols' in bitlbee help)

default_account_settings.description: Global default settings for newly registered accounts

unixsocket_path.description: Path to Unix domain socket for local clients (e.g., irssi via /dcc)

unixsocket_perms.description: File permissions for the Unix socket (octal)

http_enabled.description: Enable experimental HTTP API (not recommended for production)

http_root.description: Base URL path for HTTP API endpoints

http_password.description: Password (plain-text) to protect HTTP API endpoints

jsonrpc_path.description: Path to the JSON-RPC Unix socket
